desc:
🍀 Welcome to Break Lucky Blocks!

🎮 How to Play:

⛏️ Break lucky blocks to reveal rare Brainrots
🥷 Steal them and escape the guards
💰 Place them in your base to earn cash
⚡ Upgrade your speed and pickaxe
🏆 Collect them all in the Index!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
